summary: Definium Therapeutics filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a follow-on public offering of 20,588,236 common shares at $34.00 per share, representing a 6.0% discount to the last sale of $36.18. The issuer will receive $659.8M in proceeds before expenses. Underwriters (J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, et al.) have a 30-day option for 3,088,235 additional shares. This is a routine equity shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring is involved. The offering is expected to close on June 25, 2026. What to watch: share price performance post-offering and potential dilution effects.
